get.description:
Basic health check endpoint.

Returns:
    Dict containing basic system status

schema.title: Response Health Check Api V1 Api V1 Automation Health  Get

get.description:
Readiness check - verifies system is ready to accept requests.

Checks:
- Database connectivity
- Basic system components

Returns:
    Dict containing readiness status and component health

schema.title: Response Readiness Check Api V1 Api V1 Automation Health Ready Get

get.description:
Liveness check - verifies the service is alive and responding.

This is a lightweight check that doesn't verify external dependencies.
Used by Kubernetes for pod health monitoring.

Returns:
    Dict containing liveness status

schema.title: Response Liveness Check Api V1 Api V1 Automation Health Live Get

get.description:
Detailed health check with comprehensive system status.

Checks:
- Database connectivity and performance
- External service connectivity (if configured)
- System resource usage
- Component status

Returns:
    Dict containing detailed health information

schema.title: Response Detailed Health Check Api V1 Api V1 Automation Health Detailed Get
